title: Table 3.9a Maximum overshadowing: adjoining property (percentage of dwelling site area)

rows.note: R80 or higher: no maximum overshadowing

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Site area is the ground surface measured at NGL without regard to buildings. Footnote 1 (Chapter 3 p44): where the proposed development adjoins a grouped dwelling development, the maximum overshadowing is applied for each grouped dwelling site area and excludes portions of common property (Figure 3.9d); the applicant supplies overshadow.adjoining_pct per dwelling site. Named codes (R100-SL, LR, MR, HR) have no row. Values checked against Chapter 3: same as Chapter 2.
